localVerify.finalMeasurementChecks: Typecheck/lint/boundaries and 411 plus two expected diagnostics; 85 production cases discovered in fourteen files, three separate React profiling checks

protocol.axe: 14 complete actual page scans: default/search/card/time/settings/layers/list at desktop and phone widths. All raw results including incomplete checks retained. Zero critical/serious or WCAG A/AA violations; no rule or element exclusions.
protocol.objects: Real camera orbit/pan/zoom/layer membership, collision-independent Jupiter moons, shared one-selection navigation/focus, honest empty list and subscription cleanup.
protocol.react: Separate isolated Next build --profile; two callback-health-checked complete Explore subtree 30sec/1day-per-sec profiles (overview and open card+list), max four commits/sec, plus existing lab profile. Profiling overhead is separate from normal production timing/budgets.
protocol.timingRecorder: trace/video/screenshot off only for latency cases; functional cases retain traces
protocol.renderer: 83 SwiftShader functional cases; two response cases require verified actual physical scene GPU. Phone is viewport/touch emulation, not physical phone throughput.
protocol.cpu: No engine frame callback, providers, physics, assets or default camera math changed. List query is cold on existing UI cadence only while open; accepted P4.2 CPU pair remains separately recorded. Final P4.9 hardware/shell/cold-start/navigation gates remain open.
